verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's developer portal says you can test custom integrations and apps without risking your production account. It also offers a test account you can fill with sample data and a pre-built Postman collection for test calls, which covers the core of the story. The evidence is only short landing-page claims, though, with no detail on how the test account is provisioned or what limits it has. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on setting up the test/sandbox account and its limits, evidence that the MCP server or AI agents can point at the test account, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
